risk_summary: The disclosure is substantially quantified, providing segment trends, acquisition impacts, contract charges, and fiscal 2013 guidance, but relies on standard forward-looking disclaimers and management estimates. Key risks include defense spending reductions, sequestration, commercial aviation uncertainty, and adverse contract-margin adjustments, partially offset by expected commercial aviation growth.
